avatar.title: Change profile photo
avatar.description: Pick a photo from your device. It will be cropped square and resized for you
avatar.hint: PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF · up to 15 MB
avatar.notImage: This file is not an image
avatar.tooLarge: The image is larger than {mb} MB
avatar.unreadable: Couldn't open this image. Save it as PNG or JPEG and try again

personal.title: Personal info
personal.emailHintVerified: Verified · Changing it requires verifying again
personal.emailHint: Changing it requires a code sent to the new email
personal.themeHint: Applies to this device and changes right away, no need to save
personal.aboutPlaceholder: A short intro so your team gets to know you

email.title: Change email
email.passwordStep: Confirm your password to send a verification code to {email}
email.codeStep: Enter the 6-digit code sent to {email} · Your current email keeps working until you verify

notify.title: Notifications
notify.description: Choose which events notify you on which channel · In-app (Inbox) always notifies you about tasks assigned to you
notify.teamHint: Set by the PM in Project Settings · Not a personal channel
notify.locked: In-app can't be turned off for this event

due.1d_and_today: 1 day before, and the morning of the due date

notify.quietTitle: Do not disturb {start}–{end} and on holidays
notify.quietHint: Email / LINE are held during this time but still kept in the Inbox · Except Urgent tasks
notify.autoWatchHint: Automatically watch tasks I create, comment on, or am @mentioned in
notify.whoTitle: Who gets notified about task activity
notify.whoBody: Assignee · Reviewer · Tester · Watcher · Parent task owner (when a Sub-task changes) · People who are @mentioned · Project PM (Due change requests and Health only)
notify.whoSelf: The person who performs an action isn't notified

issue_assigned.label: Assigned to or removed from a task

issue_review_requested.label: Asked to review or test
issue_review_requested.hint: Includes PRs that request my review

issue_commented.label: New comments on tasks I'm assigned to or watching

issue_updated.label: Due date or priority of a related task changes

issue_status_changed.label: Status of a related task, or a sub-task under my task, changes

test_run_failed.label: A test fails on my task
test_run_failed.hint: Failed tests notify every channel you pick

due_request_created.label: Due date change requests waiting for my approval

due_request_decided.label: Result of my due date change request

member_joined.label: Added to a project or my role changes

project_health_changed.label: Project health changes (At risk / Off track)

plan_changed.label: Plan changed after a baseline was set

line.title: Link your LINE account to Friday Manage
line.step1: Add the LINE OA as a friend
line.step1Hint: Search for the Workspace's LINE OA in the LINE app (ask your Admin for the LINE ID)
line.step2: Send this code in the OA chat
line.expiresIn: {minutes, plural, one {Expires in {minutes} minute} other {Expires in {minutes} minutes}}
line.expired: Code expired · Get a new code
line.noCode: Get a code to start linking
line.step3: We verify and send a test message
line.step3Hint: This page changes to "Linked" automatically · You can unlink anytime, and an Admin can unlink it when an employee leaves
line.waiting: Waiting for the code from the OA chat… This page changes to "Linked" automatically
line.unlinkDescription: You won't get LINE notifications until you link again

hours.title: Working hours and leave
hours.description: Used to calculate Workload and Gantt, and to hold notifications until working hours
hours.usingWorkspace: Currently using the Workspace working hours
hours.capacityInvalid: Capacity must be a whole number from 0–80
hours.timeInvalid: End time must be after start time

leaves.title: Leave
leaves.hint: While you're on leave, the team sees an "On leave" status and people assigning you work are told you're away
leaves.datesRequired: Choose a start date and an end date
leaves.endBeforeStart: End date can't be before the start date
leaves.overlap: You already have leave in this period

ical.title: Calendar (iCal)
ical.description: See your tasks in Google / Outlook / Apple Calendar with a private link · Anyone with the link can see your tasks
ical.createdDescription: Copy it into your calendar app now · Once you close this window you can't see the link again. If you lose it, create a new one and revoke the old one
ical.revokeDescription: Calendar apps using this link will no longer be able to fetch tasks

security.title: Security
security.noPassword: No password set yet (signing in with Google / Microsoft)
security.backupLeft: {count, plural, one {{count} backup code left} other {{count} backup codes left}}
security.unlinkDescription: You can still sign in with your other linked methods
security.signOutOthers: Sign out all devices except this one
security.signOutOthersDescription: Other devices will need to sign in again and confirm 2FA again

password.title: Change password
password.setDescription: Lets you sign in with email as well as Google / Microsoft
password.changedLoggedOut: Password changed · Signed out {count, plural, one {{count} other device} other {{count} other devices}}

mfa.intro: Use an Authenticator app (e.g. Google Authenticator, 1Password) to generate a 6-digit code every time you sign in
mfa.scan: Add an account in your Authenticator app with this secret, or open it in the app, then enter the 6-digit code from the app
mfa.code: Code from the app, or a backup code
mfa.backupIntro: Keep your backup codes somewhere safe. Each code works once when you don't have your phone · Once you close this window you can't see them again
mfa.disableIntro: Enter a code from the app or a backup code to confirm
mfa.regenerateTitle: Generate a new set of backup codes
mfa.regenerateIntro: The old set stops working immediately · Enter a code from the app or a backup code to confirm
